mechanism: Levofloxacin can prolong QT interval and cause hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia; torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion increases arrhythmia risk and enhances fluoroquinolone cardiotoxicity.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) closely; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
